reason: A separate third vector after the H4/D1 transition study failed discovery and the volume-price study failed untouched evaluation. It does not alter or rescue either prior study.

allowed: raw closed M15 bars derived from M1

PREVDAY_BREAK_HOLD.event: first two consecutive closed M15 closes outside the latest fully closed D1 high or low

PREVDAY_SWEEP_RECLAIM.event: first closed M15 excursion at least 0.10 M15 ATR14 beyond latest closed D1 high or low followed by a close back inside

PREVDAY_MIDPOINT_REJECTION.event: first M15 touch of the latest closed D1 midpoint followed by a close beyond the previous M15 extreme away from the midpoint
PREVDAY_MIDPOINT_REJECTION.direction: side of the first M15 open after the D1 reference became available

INSIDE_DAY_BREAKOUT.event: latest closed D1 bar is fully inside its preceding D1 bar; first M15 close outside the inside-day high or low

THREE_DAY_BALANCE_BREAK.event: combined high-low range of the latest three closed D1 bars is at most 1.50 latest D1 ATR14; first M15 close outside that three-day range

event_rules.reference_availability: D1 bar open time plus one day not after M15 decision time

selection: Select exactly one complete discovery-gate pass with highest PF; tie within 0.01 uses lower DD then family id. If none pass, do not inspect evaluation outcomes.
